name: PCV (procarbazine, lomustine, vinCRIStine) for 1p/19q-codeleted oligodendroglioma
histology: oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted (WHO CNS grade 2 or 3)

biomarkers.1p_19q: codeleted (required; codeletion defines oligodendroglioma and gates PCV as a category 1 option)
biomarkers.note: The IDH-mutant AND 1p/19q-codeleted phenotype is a biomarker gate: it defines oligodendroglioma and makes RT plus adjuvant PCV a category 1 option (cns.txt line 617). Without 1p/19q codeletion the tumor is an astrocytoma (see cns-glioma-pcv).

lineOfTherapy: first-line adjuvant systemic therapy after radiotherapy

eligibilityCriteria.locator: cns.txt line 617 (IDH1/2-mutant, 1p19q-codeleted: RT + adjuvant PCV, category 1)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: PCV administered after radiotherapy (adjuvant), not before
eligibilityCriteria.locator: GLIO footnote (PCV after RT, per EORTC 26951), cns.txt line 721 to 722

drugs.name: Lomustine (CCNU)

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

drugs.notes: 110 mg/m2 by mouth on day 1. Delayed and cumulative nitrosourea myelosuppression; cumulative doses above 1,000 mg/m2 add pulmonary and marrow toxicity. The 1000 mg/m2 cumulative warn threshold is source-grounded; the 1100 mg/m2 hard stop is a StewardMD institutional safety margin above it and is not printed in the source. Sources: DeVita 12th ed., devita.txt line 237647 (dose), lines 15373 and 15407 (cumulative myelosuppression).

drugs.name: Procarbazine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: devita.txt line 237646 (procarbazine 60 mg/m2 x 14 days, days 8 to 21)

drugs.notes: 60 mg/m2 by mouth daily on days 8 to 21 (14 days). Weak MAO inhibitor with a disulfiram-like alcohol reaction; counsel on alcohol and tyramine. Source: DeVita 12th ed., devita.txt line 237646.

drugs.name: vinCRIStine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: devita.txt line 237648 (vincristine 1.4 mg/m2, maximum total 2 mg, day 8 and day 29)

drugs.notes: 1.4 mg/m2 IV on days 8 and 29, capped at a maximum total of 2 mg per dose (ISMP tall-man vinCRIStine; IV only, fatal if given intrathecally). Often omitted in adult practice for overlapping toxicity (physician decision). Source: DeVita 12th ed., devita.txt line 237648.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: lomustine and procarbazine are moderately to highly emetogenic on dosing days; give 5-HT3 antagonist prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: monitor for cumulative and delayed nitrosourea myelosuppression across cycles
procarbazine: avoid alcohol (disulfiram-like reaction) and tyramine-rich foods
vinCRIStine: IV only, never intrathecal; monitor peripheral neuropathy and constipation

monitoring: CBC with platelets before each cycle and at the delayed nitrosourea nadir
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each vinCRIStine dose

doseModificationRules.condition: delayed thrombocytopenia or neutropenia at cycle start
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Confirm delayed nitrosourea nadir recovery before the next cycle; reduce lomustine for cumulative myelosuppression. Physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: CNS chapter, devita.txt lines 237646 to 237648 (PCV component doses); lines 15373 and 15407 (nitrosourea cumulative myelosuppression)

guideline.locator: Oligodendroglioma pathway, IDH1/2-mutant and 1p19q-codeleted: RT + adjuvant PCV category 1 (cns.txt line 617); PCV after RT per EORTC 26951 (cns.txt lines 721 to 722)

provenanceNote: This is the PCV regimen gated to IDH-mutant, 1p/19q-codeleted oligodendroglioma, where RT plus adjuvant PCV is a category 1 option (cns.txt line 617). Component doses are the same as cns-glioma-pcv and are grounded in DeVita 12th ed. (devita.txt lines 237646 to 237648): procarbazine 60 mg/m2 days 8 to 21, lomustine 110 mg/m2 day 1, vinCRIStine 1.4 mg/m2 days 8 and 29 capped at 2 mg (ISMP tall-man). cycleLengthDays is VERIFY because the sources give the day schedule but no explicit cycle interval; resolve before ACTIVE. No dose value was invented. No hospital or endorsement claim. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
